tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /bcom ldan rdo rje gzhon nu'i smad las drag po sgrol ba'i rjes gnang skabs kyi phyag len gsal bar byed pa'i deb yid 'phrog utpal gsar pa'i do shal zhes bya ba bzhugs so// dpal ldan bla ma dam pa khrag 'thung rdo rje gzhon nu bsod nams rin chen la phyag 'tshal lo/ /phrin las rgyas par gyur cig /rtsibs bcu ldan pa gser mdog 'khor lo'i dbus/ /dpal ldan bla ma khrag 'thung phur pa 'dzin/ /lnga bcu rtsa gcig lha yi mgon po che/ /gar dgu'i nyams ldan yongs 'dzin mchog btud nas/ /gang de'i smad las drag po'i rjes gnang skabs/ /phyag len bya tshul gsal bar byed pa'i deb/ /yid 'phrog utpal gsar pa'i do shal 'di/ /ya rabs mkhas pa'i tshogs la skyes su 'bul/ /zhes mchod par brjod cing bshad par dam bcas nas/ 'dir bcom ldan 'das rdo rje gzhon nu'i smad las drag po sgrol ba'i rjes gnang gi skabs kyi phyag len 'ga' zhig brjed thor bkod pa la/ don gsum ste/ sngon 'gro dang / dngos gzhi rjes kyi bya ba'o/ /dang po ni/ thog mar sngon 'gro gtor ma dkyil chog bzhin la khyad par ni dkyil 'khor chen po sgrub cing mchod pa dang / slob ma la rjes su gnang ba bgyis par 'tshal na/ zhes brjod pa tsam yin no/ /de nas gnas yo byin rlabs phur bzlog bzhin dang / rnga byin dbab rgyas bsdus skabs dang bstun pa bgyis nas/ 'jam yod na dkar chag skyabs 'gro nas brtsams nas phur 'bring lugs la tsitta a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐ gi bar brjod/ de nas 'khor ba phur bu bzhag la/ bcom ldan rdo rje gzhon nu sogs la dbyangs/ yang dag don du ma/ bde bar gshegs su sogs dang / bde bar gshegs pa khyed ci 'dra dbyangs rol sogs phur 'bring sor bzhag la karma kro dhi shwa ri la rnga brda sprad la/ a la rol mo len/ de nas rol mo gsum brdeg len can blangs la bzhag go /de nas mdun bskyed nas a mṛ tas bsangs/

swa bha wa sbyangs/ oṃ shū n+ya tā sogs/ rdo rje khro bos zhe sdang gcod sogs nas/ rdza rnga chen mo rdza rngas mchod ces pa'i bar dang / gzhal yas dbus su gru gsum mthing nag 'bar/ /drag po rgya mdud e raṃ nyer gcig dbus/ /gru gsum mthing nag mu khyud rdo rjes spras/ /phyi rol dur khrod phyogs skyong zhing skyong klu/ /zhes pa nas/ gtso bo la mi bskyod pa/ 'khor rnams la gtso bo nyid kyis dbu brgyan zhes pa'i bar bdag 'jug na yod pas der gzigs 'tshal/ de nas mchod pa byin rlabs bsdus pa nas a mṛ tas bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las a las bandha 'bar ba'i snod yangs shing rgya che bar/ hūm̐ las byung ba'i mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ me tog bdug spos/ mar me/ dri/ zhal zas/ rol mo la sogs pa mchod rdzas bsam gyis mi khyab pa dpal kun tu bzang po'i rnam par thar pa las byung ba'i mchod pa'i sprin gyi phung po bsam gyis mi khyab par gyur/ oṃ badzra a ra li sogs nas/ bi spho ṭa ya hūm̐ phaṭa kyi bar/ de nas sgeg phreng glu gar sogs kyis mchod/ de nas rang byung gdod nas sogs nang mchod phur chung bzhin bya/ de nas dam tshig chen po la bsgral kha dang po las mi mdzad/ de nas he ru ka yi gnas bcu dang / zhes sogs nas/ bla med ma'i bar rol mo sogs rgyun bzhin/ de nas gru gsum mthing nag ma nas bzlas pa'i bar phur chen shur ma gtong tshul nang bzhin/ de nas brgyud 'debs la/ dpal ldan brtan g.yo nas/ theg chen chos kyi rgyal po la gsol ba 'debs/ zhes pa yan dkyus bzhin la de'i rjes su/ snyan brgyud lung dang rigs pa'i gter mnga' ba/ /rgyal ba'i sras po shes rab rdo rje dang / /dpag yas 'gro la byams dang snying rje can/ /mkhan po thugs rje shes rab la gsol ba 'debs/ /zung 'jug dbu ma'i lam gyis brgyud grol nas/ /grub pa'i sngags 'chang dharma kīrti'i mtshan/ /rab dga'i spyod pas gzhan don la dges pa/

/'phags pa nam mkha'i snying po la gsol ba 'debs/ /zhes dang / de nas 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi rjes su nus mthu ldan/ /sogs nas/ 'jam dbyangs kun dga' bsod nams la gsol ba 'debs/ /zhes pa'i bar dkyus bzhin/ de nas lha mchog ngag gi dbang pos rjes bzung zhing / /chos kyi sbyin pas snyan pa'i grags pa can/ /bka' gdams bstan pa'i srog shing 'jam dpal che/ /spyan snga chos kyi spyan ldan la gsol ba 'debs/ /de nas/ dus gsum rgyal ba'i rnam sprul sa skya pa/ /zhes pa nas/ legs par stsol mdzad ma la gsol ba 'debs/ /zhes pa'i bar dang / de nas sngon tshe chos kyi rgyal po tshul khrims 'bar/ /phyi rabs ngag dbang chos kyi grags pa zhes/ /dus 'dir spyan snga byams pa kun dga'i mtshan/ /sprul pa'i skye mchog dam pa la gsol ba 'debs/ /zhes pa'i rjes su/ dri med gzhung brgya sogs nas/ kun dga' bkra shis kyi bar/ dkon mchog gsum gyi bstan pa'i srog shing mchog /chos kyi rgyal po 'dzam gling skye dgu'i mgon/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa ngur smrig 'chang ba'i gtso/ /bla chen chos kyi rgyal po laྎ /ngag dbang 'gro kun dga' mdzad rigs brgya'i gtso/ /bsod nams rin chen bstan pa'i nyin mor byed/ /bkra shis grags pa sum rtsen sar sgrog pa'i/ /rgyal mtshan dpal ldan bzang po la gsol ba 'debs/ /de nas lam rim smon lam sogs dkyus bzhin mdzad/ de nas gtor bsngo/ bskang ba rgyas bsdus ci rigs/ tshogs byin rlabs nas tshogs bar pa yan bsdus pa nang bzhin mjug gsum brdeg len can/ gnyis pa dngos gzhi la slob dpon gyis brda byung phral/ e spha ra ṇa brjod pa dang mnyam du dkar po rgyang grags bus te/ bcom rol skye med ma lugs bzhin byed/ de nas skye med ma dbyangs byas nas/ karma kro dhi shwa ri ā zhes pa'i bar rgyun bzhin la mjug tu rol mo gsum brdeg len can byas la bzhag de nas gsung bshad rdzogs nas brda byung phral rol mo 'khor lo rtsibs bcu'i 'go bzhin dgu brdung gcig

hūm̐ drag po rgya mdud e raṃ nyer gcig dbus/ gru gsum nas/ dpal bskyed la zhes pa'i bar rgyun bzhin la/ dam nyams dgra bgegs sgrol ba'i las mdzod cig la tshig la mnan pa'i dgu brdung / de nas hūm̐/ yab gcig dpal chen nas/ 'khor bcas kyi thugs dam dus la babs/ zhes pa'i bar/ de nas/ dam nyams dgra bgegs bsgrol ba'i las mdzod cig de bzhin du shes par bya ste/ shar phyogs nas 'og phyogs bar rigs 'gre/ de nas dgug gzhug las bzhi gdug pa/ phur pa'i srung ma/ sangs rgyas bstan pa/ phyogs skyong bcu/ de rnams kyang gong ltar rigs 'gre/ phyogs skyong gi mjug bzhin la tshig la mnan pa'i dgu brdung gi rjes su chems brdung dang gsum brdeg len can bya'o/ /de nas bdud rtsi byin brlabs nas gser skyems bla ma rig 'dzin rdzogs nas rig 'dzin bskul/ phur kha bsgyur ba/ dgug gzhug lan gsum/ phur bzlog kun rwa nang bzhin/ de nas gsung bshad/ de nas bcom ldan dpal chen rol mo sogs bcu bdun yang gsung bshad/ de nas nga rgyal bskyed pa/ dīpta tsakra/ rgyud gsum bla ma rnams la rol mo phur bzlog nang bzhin/ yang gsung bshad/ de nas na mo bcom ldan bar lan so drug phur bzlog nang bzhin rdzogs nas gsung bshad/ de nas dgug gzhug tshar gcig nas dam tshig chen po dang / phyi nang gsang ba ma'i bar phur bzlog nang bzhin/ de nas gtor dbang la mchod rol dang / dung nas 'dra yin/ gsum pa rjes kyi bya ba ni/ rjes gnang grub nas/ lhag ma rgyas bsdus gang rigs/ gtor 'bul bstan skyong sogs dang / ye shes lnga ldan tho 'di dbu byed ye shes rgyal mtshan gyis ngag bkod rin chen yar 'phel gyi yin na'ang / mjug gi mchod bstod chad 'dug pas sngags 'chang chen pos mdzad pa'i drag po sgrol dbang gi yi ge rin chen phreng ba las/ de nas slob dpon rnams langs te/ phyi mchod kha gsos/ mchod pa byin brlabs byas/

sgeg phreng sogs kyis mchod/ rang byung shlau ka gcig gis nang mchod/ sgeg cing dpal nas/ bgegs 'dul byang chub sems kyi ngos la 'dud kyi bar bsnyen sgrub gsal byed bzhin gyis bstod nas/ ye shes lnga ldan sogs lan gsum gyis dngos grub blangs zhes gsungs las shes nus so/ /zhes pa'ang sa skya pa kun blos smras so/ /gdangs ma mdzad rjes rten yod pa rnams la brtan bzhugs kyi rjes su rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor dang / gtor mgron gyi rten med pa rnams la/ oṃ khyed kyis sems can don kun sogs la gdangs gsol mdzad rjes ye shes lnga ldan dang / oṃ khyed kyi sogs la gdangs sogs phur sgrub grol nyin bzhin/ de nas rang gi thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer snod bcud thams cad la phog pas 'od du zhu nas bsrung ba'i 'khor lo la thim/ de dur khrod brgyad la thim/ de gzhal yas khang la thim/ de 'khor gyi lha rnams la thim/ 'khor gyi lha rnams yum la thim/ oṃ shrī badzra sogs dang / ka wa sogs dang / rang bzhin sems sogs dang / smon lam bkra shis sogs rgyun bzhin la phur pa'i bkra shis rgyas pa dang / mjug mtha'i sogs/ de rnams kyis bcom ldan rdo rje gzhon nu'i smad las drag po sgrol ba'i skabs su nye bar mkho ba'i phyag len bya tshul bstan zin to/ /bcom ldan rdo rje gzhon nu'i smad las drag po sgrol ba'i rjes gnang skabs kyi phyag len gsal bar byed pa'i deb rnying dang / mthong ba brgyud pa'i phyag len sor bzhag ste/ phyogs gcig bsgrigs pa 'di la rang bzos dben cing / shes ldan kun gyis 'di la yid ches mdzod/ de ltar na yang bdag blo rmongs pa yis/ /bcings pa'i dbang gis lhag chad nor 'khrul sogs/ /mchis na phur pa'i lha tshogs rab 'byams dang / /dam can srung ma'i tshogs kyis bzod par mdzod/ /'di sbyar dge bas bdag cag dpon slob kyi/ /bsam don chos dang mthun pa'i phrin las kyis/

/dbyig 'dzin gtams nas bstan 'gror phan pa dang / /rig 'dzin rnams kyi go 'phang thob par shog /ces pa bcom ldan rdo rje gzhon nu'i smad las drag po sgrol ba'i rjes gnang skabs kyi phyag len gsal bar byed pa'i deb yid 'phrog utpal gsar pa'i do shal zhes bya ba 'di ni dbu byed dzñā na dhwa dza'i gsung las ji ltar blang ba bzhin chos med da ra drā ratna wadhas rang lo nyer bdun pa dus kyi pho nya'i lo'i gro bzhin zla ba'i dmar cha bzang po snga ma'i tshes la legs par bris pa 'dis kyang bdag cag gi rnam 'dren dam pa yab sras rnams zhabs pad bskal brgyar brtan la yun ring du 'tsho zhing bzhes la phrin las rgyas pa'i rgyur gyur cig/ //sarba maṅga laṃ// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 kun dga' blo gros/ rdo rje gzhon nu'i smad las drag po sgrol ba'i rjes gnang gi phyag len/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
